spec.situation_desc: couldn't pay a bill on time because the mobile app was down

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thistle Bank, Liam speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s Oskar Pemberton. Your app was down when I tried to pay my electricity bill, so I paid it late. I’m really unhappy that this has happened.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can see the £68.40 late-payment fee on your account, and your balance is £1,246.17. What do you need?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I want to know why your app stopped me paying on time, and what you’re going to do about the fee.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll need to check the app outage record. Can you give me your date of birth and address?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s 14 June 1988, and I’m at 22 Willow Lane, Leeds, LS6 2QJ.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Right. The payment was due on the 18th and went out on the 20th. I can’t say what will happen with the fee.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s not good enough. I couldn’t pay because your app wasn’t working, and now I’ve been charged.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ve noted the app issue as a query. I’ll check the outage record and the fee, then contact you by Friday the 25th with what I find.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And if you can’t sort it by then?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll still update you by Friday. A full written response will be sent within 8 weeks.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: So you’ll check the outage and fee, get back to me by Friday, and send a full written response within 8 weeks. Is that right?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes. I’ll check those details and contact you by Friday. That’s the next step. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, but I’m still very unhappy about the way this has been handled.
